[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | pic2 = [[Image:Tihark Orchard gardens.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view of the gardens | ingame name=Garden of Seborhin | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=394 }} The [[Garden of Seborhin]] is a fabulously grown and meticulously tended garden located just north of the [[Forum Highlands]]. Its gardeners and protectors practically live right next to it. The garden is not open to the public however, as only royalty, nobility, and persons of high esteem and standing are allowed entry; and that is usually only if they have been granted an invitation. ==Getting there== The entrance to this area is right outside the northwestern exit of [[Tihark Orchard (outpost)|Tihark Orchard outpost]]. Talk to [[Seborhin Protector Zuor]] outside the entrance in the [[Forum Highlands]]. To be allowed entry, [[Tahlkora]] must be in your [[party]], unless the party leader has already completed [[Abaddon's Gate]]. In addition, this area is inaccessible if any party member has completed [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] but has not yet completed Abaddon's Gate. Completion of Grand Court of Sebelkeh changes this area into the [[Nightfallen Garden]] instead. Only by completion of Abaddon's Gate will it revert to its pre-[[Nightfall (event)|Nightfall]] state. ==Shrines== ;[[Resurrection shrine]]s with [[bounty|bounties]]: *[[Vabbian Scout]] → [[Heket (during [[Botanical Research]]) ==Notes== {{gw2w}} * This area is converted to the [[Nightfallen Garden]] after the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] mission, until the completion of the [[Nightfall]] campaign. Therefore, you can only vanquish this area either before the mission is done (if you completed Nightfall with another character) or after you have completed the campaign. * It is possible to [[Nightfallen Garden#Getting there|retain access]] to both this area and the Nightfallen Garden. *[[Tahlkora]] must be in your party to explore this area before conversion to Nightfallen Garden. * These quests affect the spawns in this area: ** [[Garden Chores]] ** [[One Man's Dream]] ** [[Plague of Frogs]] ** [[Which Way Did He Go?]] ** [[Norn Catering]] * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 3.2% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. ** It is possible to completely explore this area by yourself during the [[Tihark Orchard]] mission, with no enemies to fight. *** This can be done at the very beginning of the mission with the use of the Assassin skill [[Death's Retreat]], [[Return]], [[Recall]], [[Heart of Shadow]] or [[Viper's Defense]], the Elementalist skill [[Ride the Lightning]] or the PvE skill [[Ebon Escape]] to get past the guards set to stop your access. *** If you do not have access to any of these skills, you can also play the mission until the Harpies attack. The guards will move to attack and you can just pass through them, allowing you to explore the area. *{{Vanquisher|count = 261|low = 214|high = 307}} ** Before completing [[Garden Chores]] there are several groups of [[Seborhin Pest]]s on the east side of the garden (square part) (23 foes). ** There are several hidden groups of [[beetle]]s along the patrol routes of [[elemental]] groups and other visible beetle groups. Try to sweep and proceed slowly or pull enemy mobs rather than charging at them. ** The [[Plague of Frogs]] quest will cause a lot more [[heket]]s to spawn. {{Explorable areas in Vabbi}} [[Category:Has Lightbringer bounties]] [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Seborhin-Garten]]
